{{Quote|Get ready to defend yourself. The Imperials are here.|Bren Derlin|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side and Dark Side scenario campaigns}}</ref>}}
This '''Battle of Hoth''' occurred around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], when Imperial forces visited [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in search of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]] and discovered a small Rebel outpost there.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I want proof of the Rebels on Hoth. That doesn't mean we have to take them alive.|Jeffren Brek|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge" />}}
[[File:Rebel_Patrol.jpg|left|thumb|Han Solo, leading a patrol]]
After losing an intense struggle for leadership with [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan mother]] [[Gethzerion]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]] was exiled from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and eventually crash-landed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Taking refuge deep within the icy caverns, she used her mastery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] ability [[animal bond]] to take control of [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] and other local creatures, creating a new pack of minions that obeyed all of her commands, both mental and spoken. Her manipulation of the beast was so complete, that it attracted many forces of the galactic scale.<ref name="DS" /> A [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]] intended to recruit the Nightsister into the service of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. He learned that her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] had crashed on Hoth and set out on the mission to find her. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] leader [[Blackhole]] also was interested in the Nightsister, having several ideas for the use of beast mastery in the espionage, he set a small detachment of ISB agents led by captain [[Jeffren Brek]] to aid Cha in his search.<ref name="DS" /> Cha's involvement had also became known to his old enemy [[Rachi Sitra]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Sitra learned from the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] from the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of the danger Kyrisa represented and, determined not to let her be found by the Empire, traveled to Hoth with a mission to find her first.<ref name="LS" />

During that time, the Alliance to Restore the Republic had discovered the distant planet Hoth and established a small outpost there, evaluating the potential of building a larger base.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Building the Base">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Building the Base}}</ref> The [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] began to think that Hoth could be the location of the next important base for the Alliance.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Plan for the Future">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Plan for the Future}}</ref> Eventually the multiple parties looking for the Nightsister on the surface of the planet began encountering resistance from Kyrisa's beasts, as well as each other. While on [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] patrol, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Col Serra]] encountered an Imperial looking for the Nightsister, but were unable to apprehend him due to a snowstorm.<ref name="DS" /> At the same time, a squad of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] led by Jeffren Brek stumbled across a group of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] members and battled them until the storm made it impossible to continue.<ref name="LS" /> Brek did not expect any Rebel to be present on the planet and sent a scout to investigate their outpost - which at that time consisted of nothing but a handful of temporary structures and multiple stacks of boxes. Before he could get any [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]], the scout was spotted by a Rebel patrol led by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and was forced to flee.<ref name="DS" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Walkers coming. Small ones, but any walkers are trouble.|Han Solo|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge" />}}
[[File:Hamstring.jpg|left|thumb|[[Rachi Sitra]] crippled an AT-PT during the battle.]]
When the presence of the outpost was confirmed, the Imperial forces requested reinforcements to deal with it. By the demand of [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], they were provided with heavy weaponry<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Missile Crate">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Missile Crate}}</ref> and even several light [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Adrick]] was in charge of the operation and soon he led one [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], two [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PTs]] and a squad of snowtroopers to the small outpost. However, the detachment was spotted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during his patrol, prompting him to return to the outpost and inform the chief of security [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]]. Derlin quickly put a well-rehearsed defensive plan into motion, and the troopers have taken their positions along the perimeter of the outpost.<ref name="LS" />

The initial assault by squad of snowtroopers escorting the AT-PTs on foot was met with heavy blaster fire, forcing them to temporary fall back. However, soon the AT-ST arrived for support and began blazing away at Rebel positions. Eventually, the SpecForce heavy weapons managed to cripple the walkers. Regardless, the snowtroopers were still putting up a good fight, and the Alliance had lost many good men. The battle ended when another blizzard began, engulfing both armies and making it impossible for them to continue. The Rebel forces have retreated back to the temporary shelters in the outpost.<ref name="LS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Rebels on Hoth? All I have is your word for it? What could they be doing on such a worthless planet?|Nevar|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge" />}}
[[File:Outpost_Guardians.jpg|right|thumb|Rebel troopers defending the outpost.]]
About an hour later, when the storm was over, the Alliance forces returned outside the outpost perimeter and began to examine the battlefield. They found a few of the Imperial bodies and discovered that one of the light AT-PTs was carried away by the wintry blast. Several patrols were formed to reconnoiter the immediate area, but no signs of the Imperials were found: with nowhere to hide, they were swept away by the full force of the storm. The Rebel outpost on Hoth remained concealed from the Galactic Empire and eventually evolved into the well-equipped [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="LS" /> The Nightsister Kyrisa had also eventually left the planet after Dark Jedi Namman Cha eventually to track her by following her beasts and, after a fierce [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] clash, persuaded her to join him.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Reptomammal Battle">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Reptomammal Battle}}</ref>

Unbeknown to Rebels, a few Imperials, including Brek, survived the mission to Hoth due to not having participated in the final battle. Several days later, they made their way aboard the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] and presented their report to their superior, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Nevar/Legends|Nevar]]. However, the incompetent General refused to believe in the Rebel presence on a planet as worthless as Hoth without solid evidence. Stating that the mission was nothing but a ridiculous adventure from the beginning, he deleted the reports, leaving the Empire oblivious about the base that the Alliance was building on Hoth until it was rediscovered by a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] over a year later.<ref name="DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle first appeared in ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'', an expansion of the'' [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' and takes place more than a year before the well-known [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] first shown in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Though at first glance the existence of this battle may be viewed as a continuity error, this battle does not contradict the [[canon]], because at the end the Rebellion believes their outpost to remain unknown to the Empire due to all Imperial forces being wiped out, and the few survivors are disbelieved at their return.
